name: fixed_and_random
label: Fixed + Random
description: Per-node roles: Fixed nodes feed every cycle; among Random nodes, at most one feeds (at the set probability); Off nodes stay idle. Non-feeding Random nodes can mimic with a no-feed motion. Advance by fixed delay, presence-clear, or BNC IN.

parameters.label: Node role
parameters.help: off = inactive, fixed = every cycle, random = at most one of these feeds (see probability below)

parameters.label: Mimic non-delivering nodes
parameters.help: When on, Random nodes that are not feeding this cycle still run a no-feed dispense. Off nodes stay idle.

parameters.label: Advance to next trial
parameters.help: fixed_delay = wait a fixed time; presence_clear = wait until the animal is off the pads; bnc = BNC IN rising edge

parameters.label: Presence-clear settle (s)
parameters.help: Used when Advance = presence_clear — presence must stay clear this long before the next trial

parameters.label: Random dispense prob
parameters.help: Chance that one Random node feeds this cycle
